items.title: The closure of the product set of two subsets of schemes over a field is the product of the closures
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For schemes X and Y over a field k and subsets A and B, the lemma identifies the closure of the set of points of X times_k Y whose projections lie in A and B with the product of the closures of A and B (statement lines 4424-4439). One inclusion is immediate. For the other the author reduces to the case where X and Y are the closures themselves, and then argues by density: given a nonempty open W of the product, the projection of W to X is nonempty open because a scheme over a field is universally open over the base, so it meets A, and then the fibre over the chosen point a is a nonempty open subset of W whose image in Y is nonempty open, hence meets B (proof lines 4441-4459). The claim is H2: a clean density argument in which the base change of the universally open morphism to the residue field of a is what makes the second projection open as well.
